text: Today I went to fix a broken front tooth. The staff at the counter informed me that my ID card was damaged and I couldn't use my social security benefits. They told me to get a new card and then use the new card today, and to pay in advance. I want to know if I can't key in information but only benefits from the card. But I confirmed that I just got the card, so there's no way it could be damaged. I feel a little disappointed, because I've been to this clinic many times already.
